title: Principal - CSO PMO
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Principal, CSO PMO will work with the Cyber Security PMO and Tech Finance to support business leads on all matters relating to contract and cost data. The role will drive spend analytics to support management decisions, identify business efficiencies, improve internal performance by optimizing processes and facilitating change, and perform business analysis to define needs and develop benefit cases for change or process improvement projects.

**About the team:**

The Cyber Security PMO partners with Tech Finance and CSO business leads to provide clear, accurate and timely financial and business information, manage commercial activity, support management decisions, and improve reporting and operational processes across the Cyber Security Office.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will support the following financial, commercial, reporting and process-improvement activities:

  

* Help the Cyber Security Office meet the need for clear, accurate and timely financial and business information on projects.
* Prepare and publish monthly reports for CSO stakeholders showing costing progress, including budget plans, forecasts, financial tracking and operational budget management.
* Extract data from repositories, support business information systems and create dashboards.
* Ensure commercial transactions are managed effectively and on time, including payments, purchase orders and cross-charging, with issues addressed promptly.
* Provide financial analysis, expertise and insight to support the development of strategies and management decisions.
* Support structured commercial performance reviews for key CSO vendors, monitor alignment with agreed contracts, and raise and escalate related risks and issues.
* Identify improvements and efficiencies in day-to-day reporting, automating activities wherever practical.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Master’s degree in Finance, Computer Science or a related discipline.
* Overall 15 Years of experience, Minimum three years of experience as an analyst, controlling specialist, or in a similar business or finance role.
* Fluent English and effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Ability to produce clear and concise management reports.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical review skills, and a logical approach that uses process checks to identify whether data aligns with expectations.
* Ability to navigate multiple systems and collaborate across different departments.
* Familiarity with financial processes, particularly purchase-to-pay, month-end processes, reporting, budgeting and planning.
* Ability to build trusting and productive business relationships with colleagues from varied backgrounds across the Cyber Security Office.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Knowledge of cyber security, or experience working within a Cyber Security Office.

* Experience using Power BI for data analysis, dashboards and visualization.
* Typical tools and technologies: Microsoft Excel, Power BI, business information systems and data repositories.

**Skills**

AI Programming, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Change Management, Compliance Risk Management, Data Mining, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI), Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, SAP Ariba, Scripting, Shareholder Communications

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Senior Project Management Business Partner - S/4 HANA PM Specialist
description:
**Job Description:**

**Shape the Future of Airbus with Us!**

  

By joining the global **BC (Cross-Programme)** organization as a founding member of the newly created **Airbus PM Office in India** , you will play a pivotal role in operating projects, programmes, portfolios, and performance management to enable efficient decision-making and execution with a high level of **PM standard.**

  

We are looking for passionate talent, whether you want to **develop your Project Management skills toward seniority** or are **an experienced PM Expert ready to mentor and innovate** , to help us reshape the future of Aircraft programmes through PM excellence .

  

Driven by an entrepreneurial mindset and our Vision 2028 ambition to build an autonomous, high-performing PM Team in India, our mission rests on three core pillars:

* **Driving PM Excellence & Global Competitiveness** : Enabling strategic impact and operational standards locally.
* **Delivering Smart PM Digital Ecosystem:** Deploying data-driven solutions and optimizing cost structures.
* **Ensuring Seamless PMBP Experience & Beyond:** Simplifying ways of working across Airbus India and broader BC activities.

  

In this role, you will be directly embedded in the **ERP Transformation Program** , one of Airbus’s most strategic enterprise initiatives, and the Digital PM Office (BCXX). We are modernizing and simplifying our legacy landscape of over 110 SAP instances, shifting to a standardized, Clean Core S/4HANA Cloud platform.

  

Our ambition is to turn our ERP into a high-velocity engine powered by embedded AI, advanced analytics, and real-time data continuity.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to harmonize end-to-end business processes, deploy reusable assets, and drive structured governance across a global portfolio of execution projects.

  

As a PM specialist within this programme, you will co-pilot critical operations, streamline execution routines, and help pave the way for the future of digital operations at Airbus.

  

**Come sharpen your craft, unleash your potential, and build the future with us!**

  

**About the Role**

Are you passionate about turning project data into strategic business value? In this role, you will

provide autonomous project management support across complex initiatives. By delivering and analyzing integrated schedules, budgets, and risk profiles, you will deliver predictive performance insights that optimize project delivery.

  

The **Project Management Business Partner (PMBP)** is an execution-focused PM specialist embedded within project teams to drive day-to-day project performance. Accountable for maintaining project schedule baselines, generating real-time performance dashboards, tracking risks, and enforcing standardized PM methods, the PMBP bridges technical project execution with strategic business objectives

  

**Key Accountabilities & Main Responsibilities**

* Project Execution & Operational Support:
  + Provide expert project management support across complex initiatives to secure baseline execution: daily project schedule structures, resource loading, and cost monitoring in accordance with Airbus PM standards (e.g., MP.PP.01/02).
  + Maintain Top-Down / Bottom-Up planning synchronization within single-source-of-truth systems.
  + Track milestone maturity, quality gates, and deliverables against time, cost, quality, and performance target
* Performance Management & Data Analytics:
  + Define, develop, and maintain integrated PM dashboards and project status reports for internal stakeholders.
  + Leverage data analytics to perform data sanity checks, monitor planning adherence, and proactively flag potential project delays before they occur.
  + Secure Planisware data integrity as the Single Source of Truth
* Core PM Governance & Risk Tracking:
  + Facilitate project routines, steering meetings, risk reviews, and decision-making workshops.
  + Execute Risk & Opportunity management processes (ARM), log mitigation action plans, and maintain project registers.
  + Support the capture of lessons learned and process improvement feedback loops.
* Process Standardization & AI Adoption:
  + Promote a "Digital-First" mindset by actively identifying repetitive PM tasks for automation.
  Utilize AI tools to summarize technical alignment meetings, draft executive status updates, and track operational action items.

  

**Dimensions**

* Team Leadership: Individual contributor role; coordinates project work packages, cross-functional contributors, and local subcontractor task units.
* Stakeholder Network: Direct operational interfaces with Project Leaders, Engineers, Domain Experts and Transnational Project Contributors.
Scope: Dedicated support to specific project work packages or domain portfolios  

  

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* Educated to a Degree level in Business Administration, Engineering, Project Management, or an equivalent field.
* Solid professional experience 3 to 5+ years in applied project management across traditional Waterfall and Agile environments.
* Explicit S/4HANA Migration Track Record:
  + Add a mandatory or strongly preferred requirement for 3+ years of direct experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation projects
* Clean Core & Cloud Architecture Familiarity:
  + Require working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Cloud / Clean Core principles, including SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), SAP Activate Methodology, and extensibility frameworks.
* SAP Module & Data Mapping Experience:
  + Include experience with legacy SAP ERP (ECC 6.0) data migration, business process re-engineering, and harmonizing multi-instance landscapes.
* Proven experience with enterprise scheduling tools for baseline control, resource

planning, and schedule tracking.

* Proficiency in analyzing operational data using advanced platforms and dedicated

dashboarding tools.

Excellent stakeholder engagement and negotiation skills with fluent English language Proficiency.  

  

**Certifications** :

* PM Certification (Iron / Bronze) or PMI-PMP is preferred.
* Agile/SAFe certifications are highly valued.
* SAP S/4HANA certifications as highly valued is preferred.
SAP Activate Project Manager Certification is highly valued  

  

**Competencies** :

* PM Processes, Methods & Tools (Advanced)
* PM Operations (Advanced)
* Project Management Fundamentals (Advanced)
* Integrative Project Planning (Advanced)
* Risk & Opportunity Management Execution (Advanced)
Stakeholder Management (Advanced)  

  

**Soft Skills** : High adaptability, structured thinking, proactive problem-solving, active listening, and strong workshop facilitation capabilities.

  

**Languages** : Fluent / Negotiation level English (mandatory). German, French is a plus

  

**Technical Stack & Tooling**

* Core PM Workplace: Planisware (E7 / Enterprise), Zoho, Agility
* Data Analytics & Ecosystem: Palantir (Skywise), Qlik Sense
* Risk & Opportunities: ARM (Active Risk Manager)
Collaboration & Automation: Google Workspace, Gemini AI  

  

**Your Benefits**

* Challenging tasks and unique high-tech products and services
* Good work-life balance in a big international company
* Actively lived values "We are one", diversity really matters
* On-the-job trainings for personal development and technical skills
* Mentoring programmes
* Flexible working hours and working time compensation
* Home office is possible
* Compatibility of family and career
Attractive salary and company benefits  

  

**Your Location**

* Site-based position with hybrid working options

* **Ensuring Seamless PMBP Experience & Beyond:** Simplifying ways of working across Airbus India and broader BC activities.

  

In this role, you will be directly embedded in the **ERP Transformation Program** , one of Airbus’s most strategic enterprise initiatives, and the Digital PM Office (BCXX). We are modernizing and simplifying our legacy landscape of over 110 SAP instances, shifting to a standardized, Clean Core S/4HANA Cloud platform.

  

Our ambition is to turn our ERP into a high-velocity engine powered by embedded AI, advanced analytics, and real-time data continuity.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to harmonize end-to-end business processes, deploy reusable assets, and drive structured governance across a global portfolio of execution projects.

  

As a PM specialist within this programme, you will co-pilot critical operations, streamline execution routines, and help pave the way for the future of digital operations at Airbus.

  

**Come sharpen your craft, unleash your potential, and build the future with us!**

**About the Role**

Are you driven to eliminate ambiguity and establish clarity across complex enterprise portfolios? In this strategic role, you will lead global performance tracking and methodology standardization for ERP Accelerator Operations. You will empower transnational teams with robust hybrid frameworks, unified toolkits, and data-driven governance to accelerate value creation and deliver predictable, high-performing outcomes.

  

The **Project Management Methods and Performance Specialist** (d/f/m) serves as a core structuring governance and methodology lead within ERP Accelerator Operations. Responsible for eliminating ambiguity and establishing end-to-end operational transparency, this role drives global performance tracking and accelerates business transformation through scalable, standardized Project Management (PM) solutions.

  

He bridges traditional enterprise governance with modern iterative frameworks, enforcing robust project lifecycles across a Hybrid methodology environment (Waterfall/LBiP & Agile/SAFe) to ensure seamless delivery, predictability, and performance alignment across transnational teams.

  

**Key Accountabilities & Main Responsibilities**

* Structuring Governance & Performance Tracking:
  + Define, establish, and maintain a standardized global performance tracking framework to drive transparency and remove operational ambiguities across ERP Accelerator Operations.
  + Establish baseline metrics, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Objective & Key Results , and health dashboards to track progress across all release trains and work packages as part of the Airbus Process ((MC.PI.02 / MC.RP.02).
  + Lead governance routines, performance reviews, and executive reporting cycles for transnational stakeholders.
* Hybrid Methodology Enforcer & Standardizer (Waterfall/LBiP & Agile/SAFe):
  + Architect, deploy, and enforce standardized PM standards and lifecycle controls bridging Waterfall / LBIP (Launch-Base Implementation Process) governance with Agile / SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) execution.
  + Define clear interaction models between traditional milestone gates (LBIP) and SAFe Program Increments (PI Planning), System Demos, and Value Stream alignments.
  + Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on PM standards, providing coaching and guidelines to Release Train Engineers (RTEs), Product Managers, PMBPs, and Work Package Leaders.
* Operational Acceleration & Scalable PM Solutions:
  + Design and roll out scalable, reusable PM toolkits, templates, and automated workflows that streamline project administration and shorten cycle times.
  + Identify operational bottlenecks, continuous improvement opportunities, and process gaps across ERP Accelerator workstreams to accelerate transformation delivery.
  + Facilitate change management initiatives to secure high adoption of standardized PM practices across global delivery centers.
* Digital Tooling and Data Integrity:
  + Secure single-source-of-truth data integrity across the PM digital ecosystem, establishing automated data validation rules between Agile tracking tools and enterprise portfolio systems.
  + Champion "PM Governance" by integrating predictive analytics to identify performance drift, schedule variance, and delivery risks before they impact target milestones.
  Propose automation of repetitive status reporting, data aggregation, and compliance auditing using advanced analytics and AI capabilities.

  

**Dimensions**

* Scope of Impact: Global governance footprint across ERP Accelerator Operations and BCX PM Office initiatives (Europe, India, and global deployment sites).
* Stakeholder Network: Direct interface with ERP Operations Executives, Value Stream Owners, Release Train Engineers, PM Office Leaders, and Transnational PMBPs.
Methodology Scope: Oversight of hybrid delivery models managing multi-million-euro digital enterprise transformations.  

  

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* Experience: 7–10+ years of proven experience in Project Management Governance, Methods & Processes, and Performance Management within complex, transnational IT/ERP or aerospace engineering environments.
* SAP Activate & Hybrid Framework Mastery: Require demonstrated experience in defining or enforcing hybrid PM methodologies combining SAP Activate (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run) with enterprise Agile/SAFe or Waterfall/LBIP frameworks.
* SAP configuration or Technical Expertise is not required but instead PM process governance for large-scale enterprise ERP/SAP transformations is.
* Process Harmonization & Quality Gate Knowledge:
Excellent stakeholder engagement and negotiation skills with fluent English language Proficiency.  

  

**Certifications** :

* SAFe Agilist (SA), SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC), or SAFe POPM / RTE certification, STE is highly valued.
* PMI-PMP, or PM Certification (Bronze/Silver).
Lean Six Sigma is a plus.  

  

**Competencies** :

* PM Processes, Methods, tools (Expert)
* PM Operations & Performance (Advanced)
* AGILE & SAFe Framework Implementation (Advanced)
* Project Portfolio Management & Governance (Advanced)
* Risk & Opportunity Management Execution (Autonomous)
Stakeholder Management & Executive Alignment (Advanced)  

  

**Soft Skills:** Exceptional analytical capability, executive presentation skills, structured problem-solving, strategic negotiation, and natural influence without direct authority.

  

**Languages** : Fluent / Negotiation level English (mandatory). German, French is a plus

  

**Technical Stack & Tooling**

* Agile & Work Management: Jira, Agility, SAFe Launchpad
* Enterprise PM & Portfolio: Planisware (E7 / Enterprise), Zoho
* Analytics & Performance Dashboards: Qlik Sense, PowerBI, Palantir (Skywise)
* Risk & Quality Management: ARM (Active Risk Manager)

title: Project Engineer (1-3 years)
description:
Inquisitech Engineering Solutions provides Engineering Services to Clients in the field of Electrical Power and Industrial automation. The candidate should have a knowledge of Electrical Design and development of LV and MV switchgear, Industrial automation for IEC or ANSI Market.

**Required Skills**

* Min 1–3 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in LV and MV switchgear industry.
* Strong hands-on experience with AutoCAD and AutoCAD Electrical.
* Strong understanding of LV/MV switchgear, electrical circuits, and protection/control schemes.
* Knowledge of PLC hardware, control logic, and I/O configuration.
* Knowledge of IEC/IS standards related to switchgear.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and modify LV and/or MV switchgear drawings.
* Select hardware materials based on the sales proposal, project requirements, and customer specifications.

title: Director - CSO PMO
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose:**

  

The Director, CSO PMO (Cybersecurity Project Delivery) is responsible for delivering a portfolio of critical cybersecurity projects that protect GSK’s information and digital assets and reduce risk from cyber-attacks. The role ensures that governance and delivery processes are effectively managed and executed, with a consistent focus on high-quality outcomes.

**About the team:**

Cybersecurity Project Management Office leads the governance and execution of the Cyber Security Office Project Delivery Portfolio. The team works with senior Tech leaders across the organisation to deliver cross-functional projects, strengthen GSK’s security posture, and keep delivery visible, predictable and aligned to strategic priorities.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Provide leadership across the cybersecurity portfolio, ensuring strategic alignment, appropriate investment prioritisation and effective governance.
* Own the project delivery capability end to end, including its roadmap, delivery standards, service performance and continuous improvement.
* Build sufficient expertise in cybersecurity concepts and technologies to understand project requirements, deliverables, risks and intended outcomes.
* Support business case development, with particular focus on business value, investment outcomes and measurable benefits.
* Apply rigorous and agile project management methods to keep multiple projects on track and resolve issues affecting scope, schedule, budget or quality.
* Ensure product owners and delivery teams follow agreed methodologies, information protection project management policies and procedures.
* Run portfolio planning cycles and maintain an integrated delivery plan covering milestones, resources, dependencies, budgets and benefits.
* Work across the CSO Leadership Team to identify and resolve resource capacity constraints and drive effective resource allocation.
* Manage portfolio risks, issues and dependencies, coordinate cross-workstream impacts, and escalate matters that are not progressing.
* Lead communications, escalation and reporting to maintain alignment and progress across delivery teams, senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Support and develop Cyber Security Project Managers, including employees and contingent workers, by setting goals, coordinating activity and establishing prioritised delivery schedules.
* Own the capability budget and supplier relationships, ensuring delivery commitments and financial performance are effectively managed.
* Build strategic relationships with Tech business-unit leadership teams to support consistent application of security policies and standards across technology projects, systems and services.
* Champion GSK values, lead with context rather than control, focus on outcomes, and demonstrate transparency, integrity, inclusion and accountability.
* Develop people through formal development programmes, mentoring and coaching, while fully supporting diversity, inclusion and equity.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* BA or BS in Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 20+ years of experience, at least 10 years of leadership experience in project and portfolio management or programme delivery.
* At least 10 years of experience managing technology delivery teams.
* Experience in technology portfolio management, including prioritisation, governance, risk management and key performance indicators.
* Experience delivering complex technology solutions across multiple global regions within a regulated industry.
* Substantial cybersecurity experience, with the ability to understand technical requirements, delivery outcomes and security risk.
* Working knowledge of delivery tracking, financial management, reporting, governance and delivery standards.
* Proven experience leading and developing technical or specialist teams and managing budgets, suppliers and delivery commitments.
* Strong influencing and communication skills with senior stakeholders in a complex, matrixed organisation.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* MA or MSc in Information Systems or Computer Science, or an MBA.
* PMP or CISSP certification; other relevant certifications such as PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2 or SAFe are also beneficial.
* Demonstrated leadership across a complex matrixed environment and with large, globally diverse teams and cultures.
* Expert skills in data analysis and visualisation using Excel and Power BI.
* Experience embedding Agile Product Management practices and combining agile and rigorous project delivery approaches.

* Experience in pharmaceuticals, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.
* Typical tools and technologies: Excel, Power BI, ServiceNow, Jira, Planview or Clarity.

**Skills**

Business Acumen, Change Management, Compliance Risk Management, Continuous Improvement, Continuous Process Improvement, Dependency Analysis, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Financial Management, Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL), Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications, Stakeholder Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

title: People Experience & Change Specialist (Associate Project Manager)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**Hello** . We’re **Haleon** . A new world-leading consumer health company. Together, we’re improving everyday health for billions of people. By growing and innovating our global portfolio of category-leading brands – including **Sensodyne** , **Panadol** , **Advil** , **Voltaren** , **Theraflu** , **Otrivin** , and **Centrum** – through a unique combination of deep human understanding and trusted science. Brands that are known and trusted to deliver. What’s more, whilst our brands have history, our company is new, fresh and forming, shaped by all who join us. We are at the forefront of building a new sector of consumer health and for Haleon, co-creating our unique culture. Care to join us. It isn’t a question.

This is an exciting time to join us and help shape the future. It’s an opportunity to be part of something special.

  

**About the team**

  

People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data-driven, and change more successful.

  

We're a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement.

Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change.

  

The HR PMO is a critical capability within this team. It provides the governance, structure and delivery discipline that turns strategic ambition into measurable outcomes. By ensuring initiatives are prioritised, coordinated and executed effectively, the PMO enables sustainable transformation and continuous improvement across the entire employee journey.

  
  

**About the role**

  

As a **People Experience & Change Specialist (Associate Project Manager)** , you will help turn CI initiatives and transformation ambitions into outcomes that deliver better employee experiences through change and transformation.

Reporting to the Programme Manager - Transformation, you will support the delivery of strategic People Solutions initiatives by providing project management discipline, stakeholder engagement, governance support and change execution.

  

You will coordinate projects from planning through implementation, ensuring milestones are achieved, risks are managed, stakeholders remain engaged and employees are prepared to adopt new ways of working. Success will be measured through high-quality delivery, strong stakeholder experiences, and the sustainable adoption of change that improves employee, manager and HR experiences globally.

  

Key responsibilities:

* Support the delivery of People Solutions transformation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time and in budget, meet business objectives and improve employee, manager and HR experiences.
* Translate project objectives into clear delivery plans, milestones and outcomes, ensuring customer experience and adoption considerations are embedded from the outset.
* Maintain project plans, RAID logs, action trackers and governance documentation to provide clear visibility of progress, risks and dependencies.
* Coordinate project activities across People Solutions, Digital & Technology, Global Process Owners, HR CoEs and regional HR teams, to ensure effective execution of solutions that are simple, scalable and user-centred.
* Produce status reports, dashboards and governance materials that support informed decision-making and leadership oversight.
* Track risks, issues and dependencies proactively, escalating where required and helping teams identify practical solutions.
* Support stakeholder engagement activities by building trusted relationships and ensuring stakeholders remain informed, aligned and engaged throughout delivery.
* Develop and execute communication, training and adoption plans that help employees and managers successfully transition to new processes, tools and ways of working.
* Assess change impacts and support change readiness activities to help minimise disruption and accelerate adoption.
* Gather feedback, insights and performance measures to evaluate the effectiveness of change and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Champion consistent project management and change management practices across the People Solutions portfolio.
* Support the continuous improvement of PMO templates, tools, governance and ways of working.
Contribute to building project and change management capability across People Solutions teams through coaching, guidance and sharing best practices.  

  

**About you**

  

Technical and functional expertise:

* 5-8 years’ experience supporting and delivering projects, transformation initiatives or change programmes in HR, shared services or a business operations environment.
* Strong understanding of project management fundamentals, including planning, governance, risk management, reporting and stakeholder management. Formal certification in (or working towards) project management methodologies (e.g. PMP, APM, PRINCE2, Agile) is advantageous.
* Experience developing project documentation, status reporting, governance packs and delivery plans.
* Understanding of change management principles, stakeholder engagement, communications and adoption activities.
* Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret data, identify trends and generate actionable insights.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders in a matrix environment.
* Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools.
Experience working with HR technologies, Workday, ServiceNow or digital transformation initiatives is advantageous.  

  

Leadership and behavioural capabilities:

* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail and follow-through.
* Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Strong communication and influencing capabilities across global, virtual and cross-functional environments.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and align multiple stakeholders around shared outcomes.
* Curious, proactive and solutions-focused, with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Resilient and adaptable, able to navigate ambiguity and changing business needs.
* Demonstrates accountability and ownership for delivering results.
* Passionate about improving employee experience and delivering meaningful business outcomes
* Strong commercial thinking, analytical capability and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrable capability to lead change, drive adoption and deliver sustainable business outcomes, preferably in complex environments.  

  

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

  

The future of everyday health is changing. And we’re the people changing it. In front of us is an incredible opportunity to go beyond what any of us have done before. And make everyday health more achievable, more inclusive and more sustainable. For more and more people.

  

So, join us, as we build one of the world’s leading consumer healthcare companies. Join us to innovate and grow our category-leading brands. To better understand people’s everyday health needs. To tackle the biggest barriers that stand in their way. To change individual and societal behaviour. Join us to work with colleagues who share your curiosity and restless energy. To explore your interests. To stretch yourself to do the best work of your career. And join us, as together we build a working experience that encourages us all to lead happier, healthier, more productive lives. The way we see it, every day is an opportunity for better. And we’re going all in to realise it.

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-06  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

* **Shape strategic change.** Take complex or ambiguous business problems and turn them into clear strategies, priorities and executable plans. Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities to simplify, digitise and reimagine how CAS operates.
* **Lead transformation end to end.** Own major initiatives from initial problem definition and business case through design, delivery, implementation, adoption and benefit realisation. Connect individual projects into the broader CAS strategy rather than managing them in isolation.
* **Reimagine client and operational journeys.** Help create simpler, faster and more transparent onboarding and servicing experiences, using strategic platforms, data, workflow, automation and AI where they can materially improve outcomes.
* **Turn strategy into executive decisions.** Distil complicated issues into clear choices, recommendations and actions. Produce high-quality written and visual materials that allow senior leaders to understand the issue quickly and make informed decisions.
* **Create alignment across organisational boundaries.** Work across Operations, Product, Technology, Data, Controls and business teams globally. Establish clear outcomes, ownership, dependencies and delivery expectations, and constructively challenge when these are at risk.
* **Drive execution with pace and accountability.** Identify blockers early, resolve issues wherever possible and escalate clearly when necessary. Maintain focus on the business outcome rather than allowing delivery to become an exercise in milestones and reporting.
* **Use data to drive decisions.** Define meaningful measures of success across client experience, controls, cycle time, automation, scalability and productivity, and use them to identify where intervention is required.
* **Embed change, not just deliver it.** Ensure new capabilities are adopted into the operating model with appropriate controls, ownership and measurable benefits. The wider CAS programme explicitly focuses on adoption, readiness and benefit capture as well as technology delivery.
* **Act as a trusted strategic partner.** Build credibility from working-level delivery teams through to executive management. Communicate candidly, adapt the level of detail to the audience and create confidence in both the direction and the execution.

**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* **Strategic thinker and strong executor** — you move between big picture and detail to turn strategy into practical action.
* **Frames unfamiliar problems** — you develop a clear point of view and an actionable plan.
* **Genuine self-starter** — you operate effectively without a tightly defined brief or constant direction.
* **Proactively drives progress** — you identify gaps, convene the right people, and move work forward.
* **Exercises sound escalation judgement** — you know when to progress independently vs. when senior engagement is needed.
* **Executive impact** — you influence senior stakeholders without relying on hierarchy.
* **Constructively challenges and clarifies** — you question assumptions, align differing objectives, and make clear recommendations.
* **Exceptional communicator** — you explain complex topics simply and precisely in writing and verbally.
* **Bridges working-level to exec-level** — you run detailed sessions and translate outcomes into concise executive messaging.
* **Commercial and outcome focused** — you measure transformation by business outcomes (controls, client experience, cycle time, automation, scalable growth), not activity.
* **Strong problem solver with risk judgement** — you apply analytical rigor with imperfect information, identify risks/dependencies/control implications early, and balance speed with well-controlled delivery.

**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* The strongest candidates will not describe themselves simply as project managers.
* They will be curious about how technology, data and AI can change the operating model, but equally focused on the people, process, controls and adoption required to turn new capabilities into real business value.

* Coordinate with multiple stakeholders to ensure project activities remain on track.

description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Job summary
  
JLL is seeking a Facilities Project Lead to support client by serving as the single point of accountability for vendor contract performance and the planning, procurement, and delivery of small facilities projects. This role ensures vendors deliver the full contracted scope at the agreed quality and cost, and that all projects follow one consistent process from request through closeout. In this role, you will help deliver the simplicity, speed, and consistency that define JLL’s integrated approach to real estate and facilities management. You will work across vendor management, project delivery, budgeting, sourcing, and team leadership while supporting JLL’s purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world and our values of Teamwork, Ethics, and Excellence.
  
  
Key responsibilitiesVendor contract management
  
Own the master register of vendor and subcontractor agreements, including scope, term, pricing, and the responsible account team member.
  
Own performance management of fixed-cost contracts and making the final determination on whether work performed meets the contracted scope, frequency, and quality standard, in consultation with technical leads and Sourcing Manager.
  
Participate in vendor performance reviews with Sourcing Manager and drive scope gaps, quality issues, and corrective actions to resolution.
  
Input into vendor contract renewals, rebids, and scope revisions, including benchmarking and recommendations on whether to renew, renegotiate, or replace.
  
Serve as the escalation point for commercial disputes, change orders, and extra-work requests.
  
Small project management
  
Maintain oversight of a single project log covering status, budget, schedule, and owner, and triage incoming project requests.
  
Develop scopes of work, issue bid packages, lead bid leveling, and recommend awards with clear cost and risk rationale.
  
Manage projects from award through closeout, including schedule, cost, change control, quality inspection, punch lists, and documentation.
  
Coordinate with clinical and operational stakeholders on access, shutdowns, and scheduling in a 24/7 Office environment, including infection control, life safety, and interim measures.
  
Ensure vendor compliance with site safety, permitting, and regulatory requirements.
  
Define and enforce a standard project process used by all project owners on the account.

Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day-to-day use. Today, 500+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.

###### **About the role**

As Associate Project Manager on Lyzr's Platform team, you will make sure platform work ships on time and everyone knows where it stands. You'll plan sprints, track delivery, clear blockers and keep engineering, Applied AI and leadership aligned.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes structure, follows through and is comfortable in a fast-moving AI company.

###### **What you'll do**

* Plan and run sprints for the Platform team: backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives
* Turn platform priorities into clear project plans with scope, milestones, owners and timelines
* Track delivery in Jira, keep boards and dashboards current, and report progress every week
* Spot risks, dependencies and blockers early, and drive them to resolution with engineering and DevOps
* Coordinate with the Applied AI team and client-facing project managers so platform work lines up with customer commitments
* Keep senior stakeholders updated on status, risks and decisions
* Document processes, release notes and decisions so the team works from one source of truth
* Use AI tools to automate status reporting and routine project tasks

###### **What we're looking for**

* 2–3 years of project management or delivery experience in a software, SaaS or AI company
* Hands-on Agile and Scrum experience running sprints for engineering teams
* Strong Jira skills: boards, workflows, dashboards and reporting
* Working understanding of cloud platforms (GCP, Azure or AWS) and how platform and DevOps teams work
* Clear written and verbal communication, with experience managing several stakeholders
* Everyday fluency with AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar
* Strong ownership: you follow through on what you commit to

###### **Good to have**

* Experience at an AI implementation or AI platform company
* A project management certification such as CSM, PSM or PMP
* Exposure to CI/CD, release management or infrastructure projects

title: Senior Customer Project Engineer - Gas Turbine
description:
As a member of the Project Engineering team, you will provide input and make decisions that influence major technical and financial outcomes for GEV and/or the customer and customer representatives.
  
  
Serve as the technical point of contact for the project’s External customer. Represent voice of customer to internal teams and voice of engineering to external teams.
  
Communicate the requirements of the project contract to GEV Internal Engineering Teams.
  
Reduce or eliminate risk on projects by resolving conflicts of interest between internal and external stakeholders.
  
Manage changes to hardware, software and contractual scope by quantifying technical impact to cost and cycle.
  
Accountable for project schedule, engineering response to customer and site during installation for engineering defects, comments or ambiguities etc., support other PEs as needed.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* The Senior GT Project Engineer provides technical project management, technical direction, and drives coordination of engineering activities and critical issue resolution for OTR-related issues for all assigned GT projects. The Senior GT Project Engineer functions as the technical liaison for the Customer and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) representatives to ensure that the supplied design documentation and equipment fully complies with the contract requirements and drives continuous improvement in project execution. This position reports to the Project Engineering Leader (Asia)

Essential Responsibilities:

This position will require coordination with customers, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction firms (EPCs), Project Management, multiple engineering organizations, Centers of Excellence (COEs), Commercial Operations, Business Associates (BAs), Global Supply Chain (GSC), Power Service Engineering (PSE) and installation/field personnel by:

* Actively own, support and analyze Pre-COD ER case trends to identify systemic design or installation risks. Translate site-learned insights into concrete engineering process improvements, transforming reactive site troubleshooting into proactive, long-term design excellence

* Participating in constructability reviews, driving systematic lessons learnt back to engineering teams.

* Driving lessons learned back into the design engineering organizations to avoid repeating issues via ERS, NCR, etc.

* Providing technical guidance to Project Management and Applications/Regional Customer Applications Engineering

* Conducting Customer Kick-Off Meetings (CKOMs), Site Kick-Off Meetings, and/or Design Liaison Meetings (DLMs) with customers and/or their design representatives (EPCs)

* Reviewing contract documentation and communicating project requirements to all design functions, utilizing internal documentation systems and regular communication with internal engineering organizations

* Evaluating the financial/schedule impacts of customer-requested scope changes via Cost & Cycle Estimates (CCEs) and implementing changes agreed to by Change Orders via the Change Management Process

* Supporting resolution of cross-functional design complexities and working to resolve technical issues

* Mitigating engineering schedule issues and taking preventative action to avoid delivery delays or late customer deliverables

* Managing the Engineering Budget and providing quarterly Estimate at Completions (EACs) to Finance with monthly risk and opportunities visibility in Live Cost Visibility (LCV).

* Providing technical support to engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, suppliers, and installation personnel to ensure equipment meets all customer requirements and business objectives until handover to services / COD.

* Help establish and execute new project engineering process for handing pre-COD site queries / issues via ER case in ServiceNow tool.

* Presenting project issue resolutions periodically to upper management, highlighting risks, and creating action plans to remedy the risks

* Taking robust handover from application teams (ITO), performing comprehensive handoff to design team in OTR and ensuring project closure with clean handoff to services team

* Executing assigned projects with an ITR mindset.

* Demonstrate AI adaptation for simplification, speed and accuracy of day to day PE tasks.

  
  

**What you’ll bring (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited college or university.

* Minimum 10 years of experience in engineering and /or project management, preferably within the Power Plant Industry in an international project environment, out of which 5 years of working with direct customer interface.

**Eligibility Requirement:**

* Ability and willingness to travel, as required ~10%

* Ability and willingness to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

* Leadership-quality communication skills, both verbal and written

**What will make you stand out**

* Customer-facing experience

* Experience in managing installation and commissioning technical support and Engineering Response (ER) workflows.

* Proven ability to translate field-based technical feedback into scalable design solutions.

* Demonstrated commitment to Zero-Defect Framework principles, with experience in managing complex technical change control in high-pressure project environments

* Demonstration and adherence to Vernova Way Behavior

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Sr. Program Manager Enablement
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a Senior Program Manager to enable our revenue teams in India. You will have previous experience as Account Executive or Enablement Program Manager with a strong track record of executing strategic sales enablement initiatives. This role will be responsible for enabling our New logo Sales Account Executives.

You’ll partner with sales leaders to diagnose sales performance gaps, choose the right intervention, and take programs from an initial brief through adoption and measurement. That might mean a live training, a practice workshop, a certification, a manager reinforcement plan, a playbook, or a process change. You will be responsible for delivering relevant, consumable content to our teams.

You’ll make complex product and sales concepts usable for the teams you support, and help managers reinforce behavior after launch.You’ll jointly identify opportunity areas for new training approaches, certifications, processes, and assets for the sales team. After you deploy programs to sales teams, you’ll develop systems to measure business impact and iterate as necessary. This is an opportunity to meaningfully play a role in driving Rippling’s growth by developing and testing strategies for all segments of our sales teams to improve their respective close rates and average contract values.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can act as a strategic partner and still deliver excellent work at pace. This role will directly impact and improve our buyer journey across all sales segments.

You’ll work across multiple cross functional stakeholders like Sales implementation, Product launch teams, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, and the broader Revenue Enablement team.

You’ll love this role if you’re passionate about revenue growth and Enablement, getting into the details, deeply understanding why an enablement program is or isn’t resonating, using data to motivate your peers, and making a significant impact on revenue.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Program Manage & Own Enablement Functional Expertise:
* + Oversee multiple enablement projects, ensuring timely execution and alignment with strategic goals. Thrive in fast paced, highly ambiguous environments and get projects to completion
  + Develop and manage end-to-end enablement programs, including onboarding LPs, everboarding programs, sales documentation, and ongoing comms to ensure your programs stick
  + You will become a domain expert in all things Rippling New logo Sales so you can have a meaningful impact on strategic decision making
* Communication & Stakeholder Management:
* + Set clear expectations, foster collaboration & execute on deliverables autonomously.
  + Partner with Sales leadership & broaden enablement team to drive large initiatives.
* Presentation / Facilitation Skills:
* + Design clean, non-text heavy presentations that deliver sales-consumable information to audiences
  + Utilize various adult learning modalities (interactivity, polling, questioning, role play, etc.) to ensure information transfer
  + Excel in live sales training facilitation ( sales skills training, new process updates, product rollouts )
* Analytical Skills:
* + Review and analyze data to inform enablement recommendations based on business gaps.
  + Define baseline & leading indicators before launch, review adoption & performance with stakeholders, share what’s working, what’s not & iterate.
  + Interpret key performance metrics to identify opportunities for impact and ensure rapid AE ramp-up and effectiveness.
* Content Development:
* + Create & maintain concise, polished, accessible playbooks, guides & reference materials for the sales teams.
  + Create and update onboarding content for new sales reps, ensuring relevance and accessibility.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* At least 5 years of relevant experience in Enablement, Program Management, Product Marketing, and / or Sales, with examples of complex programs you led from diagnosis through measurable adoption.
* Strong facilitation & instructional design judgement, including the ability to make complex material clear, practical, and engaging for sales audiences
* Ability to thrive in very fast-paced environments, effectively managing shifting priorities and handling multiple tasks without becoming easily overwhelmed
* Ability to build trusted relationships, influence without authority & drive quick decisions
* Excellent program management : prioritisation, backward planning, crisp documentation, navigating ambiguity & escalating risks early.
* An aptitude for problem-solving and working cross-functionally with others
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and organizational skills including high attention to detail, high speed & high ownership
* Self-starter with a bias towards action
* SaaS sales acumen and the curiosity to become a credible expert in Rippling’s products, customers & sales motions.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Manager I, Project Management
description:
Job Description:

The **BTEX Transformation Project Lead** serves as the program delivery owner for strategic initiatives across Schneider Electric's global Business Travel & Expense program. The role is accountable for delivering BTEX transformation initiatives and converting travel, expense, payment, and operational data into actionable business intelligence, driving process optimization, digital innovation, and measurable business outcomes.

Working across regions and functions, the role will lead global delivery governance, conduct end-to-end T&E data and process mining assessments, and introduce AI-enabled innovation that improves employee experience, operational efficiency, cost transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Program Delivery Ownership**
---------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end delivery of global BTEX transformation program projects from initiation through implementation, stabilization, and benefits realization.
* Define and maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, budget, resources, dependencies, risks, decisions, and acceptance criteria.
* Establish delivery governance, workstream cadence, decision forums, executive status reporting, and escalation mechanisms.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams and external partners to ensure timely delivery, clear accountability, and rapid issue resolution.
* Monitor delivery performance and business outcomes; implement corrective actions when milestones, quality, adoption, or value realization are at risk.

**2. Global T&E Process Mining and Process Excellence**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead global process mining assessments across travel booking, corporate card, expense submission, approval, audit, reimbursement, accounting, and payment processes.
* Define process-mining scope, required event data, process variants, control points, performance indicators, and target outcomes in partnership with process and data owners.
* Identify bottlenecks, rework, manual activities, policy deviations, control gaps, and automation opportunities across countries and regions.
* Translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps, standardized processes, control enhancements, and measurable efficiency initiatives.
* Embed continuous monitoring and value tracking to sustain improvements after implementation.

**3. AI-Enabled Ways of Working and Project Delivery**
------------------------------------------------------

* Embed AI into BTEX ways of working to improve productivity, collaboration, decision-making, and execution.
* Apply AI tools across project management activities, including planning, meeting preparation, documentation, status reporting, risk identification, action tracking, and stakeholder communication.
* Identify repetitive or manual activities that can be simplified or automated using approved AI capabilities.
* Promote practical AI adoption by developing reusable prompts, templates, working practices, and guidance for the BTEX team.
* Partner with Digital, Data, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure responsible and secure use of AI.
* Track the adoption and measurable impact of AI on project efficiency, delivery quality, employee experience, and business outcomes.

**4. Business Analysis, Data and Value Realization**
----------------------------------------------------

* Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process designs, data needs, and implementation priorities.
* Use travel, expense, card, supplier, policy, and operational data to validate improvement opportunities and support delivery decisions.
* Define program KPIs, baselines, target benefits, adoption measures, and post-implementation performance reviews.
* Partner with analytics teams to develop executive reporting and decision-support views that demonstrate progress and realized value.

**5. Stakeholder, Change and Adoption Management**
--------------------------------------------------

* Build alignment with global and regional stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Accounting, HR, Digital, Compliance, Security, Sustainability, and business operations.
* Lead requirements workshops, process reviews, design sessions, governance meetings, and executive steering updates.
* Develop change, communication, training, readiness, and adoption plans appropriate to impacted audiences.
* Act as a trusted delivery partner who balances global standardization, local requirements, user experience, governance, and implementation feasibility.

**6. Technology and Vendor Delivery Management**

* Plan and monitor all construction activities, including excavation, foundations, RCC works, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, flooring, painting, plumbing, electrical, and finishing works.
* Ensure construction activities are carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly progress against project targets and implement corrective actions wherever required.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues.

B. Site Management and Team Leadership

* Lead and supervise site engineers, supervisors, surveyors, safety personnel, and other project staff.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor the performance of the site execution team.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure timely execution of work.
* Conduct regular site meetings and review progress, quality, safety, and resource requirements.
* Ensure proper manpower deployment, equipment utilization, and material availability at the project site.

C. Commercial and Cost Control

* Monitor project expenditure against the approved budget and maintain effective cost control.
* Review BOQs, quantities, subcontractor quotations, work orders, and material requirements.
* Control wastage of materials and optimize manpower, equipment, and other project resources.
* Verify subcontractor bills, measurement sheets, and work completion statements before approval.
* Monitor variations, extra items, and additional works, ensuring proper documentation and approval.
* Coordinate with the commercial and procurement teams to achieve project cost and profitability targets.

D. Quality Control

* Ensure construction work complies with approved drawings, technical specifications, and applicable building standards.
* Implement quality control procedures for concrete, reinforcement, masonry, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP works.
* Coordinate material inspections, field tests, laboratory tests, and quality inspections.
* Ensure defects and non-conformities are identified, documented, and rectified promptly.
* Maintain inspection records, test reports, and other project quality documentation.

E. Safety and Compliance

* Ensure compliance with site safety rules and applicable statutory requirements.
* Implement safe working procedures and conduct regular site safety inspections.
* Ensure workers and subcontractors follow appropriate PPE and safety practices.
* Coordinate with safety personnel to prevent accidents and unsafe working conditions.

F. Procurement and Material Management

* Prepare and review material procurement schedules based on the construction programme.
* Coordinate with procurement and stores teams to ensure timely availability of construction materials.
* Verify material quality, quantities, specifications, and delivery schedules.
* Monitor stock levels, material consumption, and wastage at the site.

G. Client Coordination and Reporting

* Act as the primary point of contact for project-related coordination with the client, consultants, and management.
* Review project progress with the client and management at regular intervals.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
* Communicate project risks, delays, cost variations, and technical issues to senior management.
* Maintain proper project documentation, including drawings, approvals, work orders, and progress records.

H. Project Handover and Closure

* Plan and supervise finishing works, testing, commissioning, and snag rectification.
* Ensure completion of all works according to the approved specifications and agreed scope.
* Coordinate final inspections, statutory approvals, and client handover requirements.
* Ensure preparation of as-built drawings, warranties, operation manuals, and completion documents, as applicable.
* Complete project closure activities within the agreed timeline.

3. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering.
* Additional qualifications in construction or project management will be an advantage.

4. Experience and Technical Requirements

* 8–10 years of overall experience in civil construction.
* Strong experience in residential building projects, including apartments, villas, and multi-storey buildings.
* Proven experience in managing end-to-end construction execution.
* Good knowledge of RCC structures, finishing works, waterproofing, and MEP coordination.
* Experience in project planning, budgeting, BOQ, billing, procurement, and subcontractor management.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Excel; knowledge of MS Project or other planning software is preferred.
* Good understanding of quality control, construction safety, and applicable building regulations.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Completion of the project within the approved schedule.
* Control of construction costs within the approved budget.
* Achievement of project quality standards with minimal rework.
* Effective control of material wastage and labour productivity.
* Timely completion of construction milestones.
* Effective management of subcontractors and project resources.
* Timely resolution of site issues and client complaints.
* Successful project completion and handover within the committed timeline.

6. Required Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management.
* Excellent planning, organizing, and execution skills.
* Commercial awareness and cost-control capability.
* Problem-solving and decision-making ability.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.

7. Overall Accountability

The Project Manager shall be accountable for the overall planning, execution, commercial control, quality, safety, and timely completion of the assigned residential building project, in line with the company's objectives and commitments made to the client

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Are you looking to expand your expertise in project management and drive change in an environment that allows you to design novel approaches and solutions? If so, this General Project Management Project Manager role could be an ideal opportunity to explore.

===============

  

Our Win as One Framework is a simple, stretching definition of our future direction. It includes our purpose, ambitions, strategic drivers, and behaviours that will enable us to Win as One. This framework guides our decision-making, strategy, and culture. The successful candidate will demonstrate the following capabilities:
