title: Management Trainee – Technology Projects
description:
Skynetic Ventures builds practical AI solutions that solve real-world business and industrial problems. Our focus areas include Computer Vision, Industrial AI, Enterprise AI, video analytics, and intelligent automation.

We work with businesses to identify opportunities, develop AI-powered solutions, and deploy technology that delivers measurable operational outcomes.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented **Management Trainee – Technology Projects** to support the planning, execution, and delivery of technology projects, from initial client discussions through development, deployment, and handover.

The candidate will work closely with leadership, engineering teams, technology partners, and clients to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to agreed requirements.

This role is suited to candidates who combine analytical thinking, business understanding, communication skills, and an interest in emerging technologies. The selected candidate will gain hands-on exposure to AI project management, software development coordination, client management, and technology deployment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Project Management

* Assist in planning and executing AI, Computer Vision, and enterprise AI projects.
* Prepare project plans, timelines, milestones, task trackers, and status reports.
* Coordinate with engineering teams to track development, testing, integration, and deployment activities.
* Monitor project progress, identify delays and dependencies, and escalate risks proactively.
* Maintain project documentation, meeting minutes, action items, and delivery checklists.

2. Technical Coordination and Solution Understanding

* Develop a working understanding of Skynetic's technology solutions, including AI applications, computer vision models, software platforms, APIs, and cloud-based systems.
* Understand client requirements and translate them into structured project requirements and actionable tasks.
* Coordinate with developers, AI engineers, and technology partners.
* Track integration between software applications, APIs, databases, and third-party platforms.
* Assist with software testing, validation, issue tracking, and deployment readiness.

3. Client and Stakeholder Management

* Participate in client meetings, requirement-gathering sessions, project reviews, and product demonstrations.
* Prepare presentations, project proposals, technical documentation, and progress updates.
* Follow up with clients and internal teams to ensure timely closure of action items.
* Track scope changes, client feedback, acceptance criteria, and project deliverables.
* Support client onboarding, user training, and project handover.

4. Budgeting and Commercial Coordination

* Assist in preparing project estimates, resource plans, and cost sheets.
* Track project budgets, actual expenditure, resource utilisation, and cost variances.
* Support preparation of technical-commercial proposals and statements of work.
* Maintain records of project costs and support invoicing and milestone-based payment follow-ups.
* Help monitor project scope to prevent unplanned work and cost overruns.

5. Product Development and Process Improvement

* Work with the team to convert recurring project requirements into standardised product features and deployment processes.
* Maintain product requirement documents, issue logs, test cases, and release checklists.
* Research relevant AI technologies, software platforms, tools, and potential integration partners.
* Identify opportunities to improve project execution, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
* Help establish repeatable project management processes as Skynetic scales its technology business.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Proficiency in basic AI tools.
* Familiarity with project planning, task tracking, and documentation.
* Willingness to understand technical systems and learn new technologies quickly.
* Ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and a bias towards execution.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or another engineering discipline; or an MBA in Operations, Technology Management, Project Management, or Business Administration.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Trello, Asana, Notion, or equivalent project management platforms.
* Basic understanding of software development, APIs, databases, cloud computing, or AI/ML concepts.
* Exposure to software implementation, business analysis, technology consulting, or product development projects.
* Internship experience in project management, consulting, operations, business analysis, or technology startups is an advantage.

**Candidates are not expected to be AI developers or expert programmers.** However, they must be comfortable learning technical concepts, asking the right questions, understanding project dependencies, and coordinating effectively with technical teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against measurable outcomes, including:

* Timely completion of project milestones and deliverables.
* Accuracy and consistency of project tracking and documentation.
* Effective coordination and closure of pending tasks.
* Timely identification and escalation of project risks and blockers.
* Adherence to approved project budgets and resource plans.
* Quality of client communication and project reporting.
* Successful coordination of software testing, deployment, and handover activities.

Career Growth

The role offers hands-on exposure to AI and enterprise technology projects, with opportunities to grow into positions such as:

* Technology Project Manager
* Technical Program Manager
* Product Operations Manager
* AI Solutions and Implementation Manager

Career progression will depend on demonstrated ownership, technical understanding, and project delivery performance.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is organized enough to manage project trackers, analytical enough to understand dependencies, commercially aware enough to monitor budgets, and curious enough to understand how technology works.

The ideal candidate does not need to know every answer but must be willing to find answers, follow through on commitments, and take ownership of getting things done.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**Introduction:**  
Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.
  
  
Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.
  
  
We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.
  
  
This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.
  
  
ABOUT
  
Pivotree is an AI-first company using cutting edge models from Gemini, Claude, CoWork and others. We use AI to automate and augment our workflows, develop new products, and find new ways of doing business. All employees use AI every day in their work and as part of teams continuously improving how we deliver.
  
As Senior Project Manager at Pivotree, you own end-to-end delivery for complex client engagements, managing scope, schedule, budget, and quality with independence. You lead Lead Project Managers assigned to individual workstreams. You bring strong stakeholder management and risk discipline to every project, and you use AI-assisted tools to accelerate status reporting and risk analysis while maintaining the judgment that keeps projects genuinely on track.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  
**Own end-to-end delivery for assigned client projects:** scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, and quality.
  
Lead Project Managers assigned to individual workstreams; ensure alignment and consistent governance.
  
Define and maintain project plans, RAID logs, and governance structures appropriate to project complexity.
  
Apply AI-assisted analytics to track schedule variance and resourcing risk; validate all AI-generated risk flags with project management judgment before acting.
  
Lead project status meetings and steering committee updates; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.
  
Use AI writing assistance to accelerate status reports and steering committee materials; review and validate all AI-generated content before distribution.
  
**Manage project financials:** budget tracking, forecasting, and margin performance for assigned engagements.
  
**Own risk and issue management:** proactively identify risks and drive mitigation before they impact delivery.
  
Partner with Business Analysts, Architects, and engineering teams to ensure delivery stays aligned to scope and quality standards.
  
Manage client relationships day-to-day, building trust through transparent communication and consistent delivery.
  
Mentor Portfolio Coordinators and Project Managers on delivery discipline and AI tool usage.
  
  
WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE
  
**Analysis:** Identifies project risks and interdependencies before they become delivery issues. Uses AI-assisted analytics to accelerate risk identification, but applies project judgment before acting.
  
**Customer Orientation:** Manages the project around the client's real business outcomes, not just the contracted scope.
  
**Decisiveness:** Makes clear decisions on scope trade-offs and resourcing without unnecessary delay.
  
**Organizing Work:** Governs a project with clear milestones, dependencies, and reporting cadences.
  
**Working with Others:** Builds trust with client stakeholders and cross-functional delivery teams.
  
**Developing Others:** Mentors Portfolio Coordinators and Project Managers on delivery discipline and AI tool usage.
  
**Initiative:** Identifies project risks and process improvements proactively; brings proposals to delivery leadership.
  
**AI-First Mindset:** Uses AI tools to accelerate risk analysis, status reporting, and steering committee materials. Validates every AI-generated artefact with project management judgment before it reaches clients.
  
  
SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
  
7 to 10 years of project management experience delivering complex technology engagements.
  
Deep expertise in project governance, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
  
Strong financial acumen; experienced managing project budgets and margin outcomes.
  
Uses AI-assisted analytics and writing tools to accelerate reporting; validates all AI-generated content before client delivery.
  
  
TECHNICAL SKILLS
  
**Project management tools:** expert in Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent.
  
**AI-assisted project analytics:** uses AI tools for risk pattern detection and schedule variance identification; validates all outputs before acting.
  
PMI-CAPM or PMO-PMP or Prince 2 Certification, PMO-ACP or CSM or SAFE certification and any AI related certifications will be of added advantage
  
**Financial management:** proficient in project budget tracking and margin analysis.
  
**Executive communication:** skilled in producing steering committee materials and status reports.
  
  
Pivotree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace.

The Project Management Lead for India oversees the performance, growth, and technical excellence of the PM and DM teams supporting global projects. The PM Lead strengthens Malaysia as a strategic delivery hub and serves as a senior leader in client engagement, project governance, and talent development.

* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, large-scale projects.
* Excellent stakeholder management and client engagement skills.
* Strategic mindset with a track record in business development and winning work.Strong communication, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. description:

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Take on a new challenge and apply your **Project Management** skills in the exciting cutting-edge field of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. You'll play a pivotal role in ensuring effective delivery of enterprise grade digital and AI‑enabled initiatives to support operational excellence at Alstom.

Day‑to‑day, you’ll collaborate with cross‑functional stakeholders to shape AI use cases end‑to‑end — from problem framing and feasibility, through requirements and backlog refinement, to planning and tracking project activities, managing timelines and milestones, and supporting coordination across business, PMO, and delivery teams. You’ll contribute to solution design discussions, assist in backlog refinement, and help ensure smooth execution and adoption of digital initiatives.

Job Description - Assistant Project Manger
  
**Job Title:** Assistant Project Manger - MEP
  
**Industry:** Industrial Construction / Project Management Consultancy (PMC)
  
Role Overview / Purpose
  
Seeking an experienced Assistant Project Manager MEP to lead the planning, design coordination, and execution of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems for commercial building projects. This role serves as the technical authority for MEP systems integration, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Assistant Project Manager MEP will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including architects, structural engineers, contractors, and clients to deliver exceptional building performance.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Project Management & Execution
  
Lead MEP design coordination from concept through construction completion for commercial building projects ranging from office buildings to mixed-use developments
  
Develop comprehensive project schedules, critical path analyses, and milestone tracking for MEP work packages
  
Manage project budgets including cost estimation, value engineering proposals, and expenditure tracking to maintain financial targets
  
Conduct regular site inspections to verify installation quality, compliance with design specifications, and adherence to safety protocols
  
Commercial & Budget Management
  
Oversee project budgets, cost control, and financial performance for projects
  
Review and approve contractor claims, variations, and running account (RA) bills.
  
Monitor cost-to-completion forecasts and implement corrective measures for budget overruns.
  
Support commercial negotiations with contractors, vendors, and consultants.
  
Technical Coordination & Design Oversight
  
Review and coordinate MEP design documents, ensuring integration between mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems
  
Facilitate BIM coordination sessions to identify and resolve conflicts between MEP systems and architectural/structural elements
  
Evaluate mechanical system selections including HVAC equipment, controls, and distribution systems for optimal performance and efficiency
  
Oversee electrical load calculations, power distribution design, lighting systems, and emergency power provisions
  
Review plumbing layouts, domestic water systems, sanitary and storm drainage, and fire protection system designs
  
Stakeholder Management
  
Serve as primary MEP technical liaison with clients, addressing concerns and providing regular project updates
  
Manage relationships with MEP contractors, subcontractors, and vendors throughout design and construction phases
  
Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, and other consultants to ensure seamless design integration
  
Facilitate submittal review processes, RFI responses, and change order evaluations
  
Quality Assurance & Compliance
  
Ensure all MEP systems comply with applicable building codes, safety regulations, and jurisdictional requirements
  
Implement quality control procedures including testing, commissioning oversight, and performance verification
  
Manage risk identification and mitigation strategies for MEP-related project challenges
  
Prepare comprehensive documentation including progress reports, technical memoranda, and lessons learned summaries
  
Required Qualifications
  
Education & Experience
  
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline from a reputed institution.
  
8 to 10 years of progressive experience in MEP project management within Industrial construction
  
Demonstrated track record of successfully delivering MEP systems for projects valued at $10M+
  
Technical Proficiency
  
Advanced knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and BIM 360 for design review and coordination
  
Proficiency with Navisworks or similar clash detection software
  
Experience with MS Project or equivalent scheduling tools
  
Familiarity with electrical load calculation software and hydraulic analysis tools
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
ASHRAE, NFPA, or IEEE membership demonstrating commitment to professional development
  
**Specialized experience in specific building types:** Class A office buildings, hospitality, healthcare facilities, or retail developments
  
Experience with commissioning processes and LEED certification projects
  
Previous mentorship or supervision of junior engineering staff
  
Technical Competencies
  
Mechanical Systems
  
HVAC system design principles including chilled water plants, boilers, air handling units, and variable refrigerant flow systems
  
Ventilation requirements, indoor air quality standards, and energy recovery systems
  
Building automation and controls integration
  
Electrical Systems
  
Power distribution from utility service through branch circuits
  
Emergency power systems, generators, and UPS configurations
  
Lighting design, photometric analysis, and advanced lighting controls
  
Fire alarm, security, and low-voltage systems coordination
  
Plumbing & Fire Protection
  
Domestic water, sanitary, and storm drainage system design
  
Sprinkler system hydraulics and fire pump requirements
  
Plumbing fixture sizing and water conservation strategies

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
### **Job Title**

Senior Program Manager

### **Job Description**

**Senior Program Manager – Intelligent Systems & AI**

At Philips, our purpose is to improve people's health and well-being through meaningful innovation. Across enterprise imaging, radiology, cardiology and digital pathology, our healthcare informatics solutions help clinicians and health systems turn complex data into better-informed decisions. Doing that at scale takes more than great products: it takes exceptional technology, operations and execution behind them.

That is where Intelligent Systems & AI (IS&AI), within Philips Healthcare Informatics, comes in. We connect business priorities with platforms, data, automation and AI to improve how our business sells, delivers and supports customers. From commercial and service workflows to enterprise technology transformation, we work across teams and systems to remove friction, improve outcomes and create lasting value. We are looking for someone who wants to help build that future, not simply manage a plan.

  

**The opportunity**
-------------------

You will lead high-impact, cross-functional technology programs from an ambiguous business problem to an implemented solution and measurable result. You will partner closely with business leaders, product managers, engineers, architects and technology partners. Expect to move between strategic choices and operational detail, influence technical trade-offs, unblock teams and help reshape how programs run in an AI-enabled organization. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a reporting-only PMO position.

  

**Your Role**
-------------

* Translate customer and business problems into clear goals, success measures, practical scope and decisions. Work backwards from customer experience, adoption, productivity, cost or revenue impact rather than treating delivery milestones as the finish line.

* Drive complex programs from discovery and prioritization through design, build, integration, launch, adoption and value realization. Make sequencing and capacity trade-offs, resolve blockers and take accountability when plans change.

* Work closely with engineering and architecture on systems, APIs, data flows, integrations and technical dependencies across CRM, CPQ, ERP, service platforms and other enterprise applications. Understand enough to ask the hard questions and challenge choices constructively.

* Align commercial and service business leaders, product teams, engineering, operations, vendors and system integrators around one coherent roadmap. Build accountability and make decisions without relying on formal authority.

* Establish fit-for-purpose operating mechanisms that show the real risks, dependencies, owners and decisions. Communicate trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and distinguish meaningful progress from status reporting.

* Use AI, automation and modern digital tools to reduce coordination overhead, detect issues earlier and improve decision quality. Experiment, learn and scale what works, with appropriate security, privacy and human accountability.

  

**You may be a great fit if you**
---------------------------------

* Have 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise software, digital transformation or technical programs spanning multiple teams, systems and business stakeholders.

* Bring experience from product-led technology, cloud/SaaS or enterprise-platform businesses, or from technology and digital transformation consulting where you owned delivery through implementation and adoption - not just strategy, governance or reporting.

* Hold a master's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business or a related discipline, or an MBA. Comparable exceptional experience in technical program leadership may also be considered.

* Think from first principles: you can break down an unclear problem, test assumptions, identify the real constraint and make sensible decisions with incomplete information.

* Have a track record of personally moving difficult programs forward and can explain the decisions you made, the trade-offs you navigated and the business or customer outcomes that resulted.

* Combine strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You are as comfortable framing a direction with executives as getting into the details with engineers or removing a delivery blocker.

* Bring practical technical fluency in enterprise systems, cloud or SaaS platforms, integrations and data; you can collaborate credibly with product and engineering without needing to be the person writing production code.

* Are an effective, concise communicator who earns trust across functions and cultures, surfaces uncomfortable facts early and makes complex decisions understandable.

* Are curious and comfortable using AI tools in your own work today, with a strong appetite to experiment and continuously improve how you and your team operate.

**How we work together**  
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

#LI #Healthcareinformatics

**About Philips**  
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

title: Product Lifecycle Program Manager
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
The Product Operations team plays a critical role in delivering Cisco’s next-generation hardware products on a scale. Working at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing, the team ensures seamless product lifecycle execution—from new product introduction to high-volume production and customer delivery. With a strong focus on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence, the team drives impact across global operations and enables successful product outcomes.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
The Cisco Product Operations team is seeking a seasoned Product Lifecycle Program Manager (PLPM) to provide strategic leadership over global cost management and the end-to-end product lifecycle from inception to End-of-Life (EOL). This is a high-visibility, senior-level role that requires the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders—including Manufacturing, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership—to align on strategy and execution for a portfolio of complex product solutions. You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Cost Management& Lifecycle Oversight: Serve as the primary architect for end-to-end product lifecycle strategy, driving rigorous cost management protocols from launch through EOL to ensure sustained profitability.
* Engineering Change Governance: Provide authoritative oversight for Engineering Change Management, ensuring seamless technical transitions and minimal operational disruption.
* Product Quality& Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets.
* Complex Problem Resolution: Lead the mitigation of critical sustaining issues, including line-stop resolutions, CAP account management, AVL optimization, and continuous manufacturing process improvement.
* EOL Strategy& Orchestration: Direct the development and execution of holistic EOL strategies, partnering with integrated product teams to ensure smooth sunsetting of legacy solutions.
* Enterprise Risk Management: Oversee proactive risk assessment, including multi-source technology evaluation, component-level analysis, cost variance mitigation, and comprehensive supply chain reviews throughout the lifecycle.
* Field Performance& Margin Optimization: Lead strategic action planning for product field performance and spearhead initiatives to drive continuous improvement in gross margins.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related technical field.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in Supply Chain management within the high-tech sector.
* Proven track record in complex Program Management and executive-level stakeholder management.
* Deep expertise in supply chain dynamics, specifically within high-tech environments, product costing, and sophisticated margin analysis.
* Advanced knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and sustaining product support

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Master’s degree in Engineering or Supply Chain Management and/or MBA.
* Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes.
* Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification.
* High proficiency in Agile methodologies and advanced MSFT tools.
* Extensive experience in the high-tech electronics industry and large-scale electronics manufacturing.
* Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

description:

Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Project and Development Services – India
  
  
Project Lead - High-Rise Greenfield Projects / Commercial projects
  
Position Overview
  
We are seeking an accomplished Project lead to lead the delivery of high-rise greenfield construction projects/Commercial projects from inception through completion. This senior leadership role requires extensive experience managing complex vertical construction while coordinating multiple disciplines, ensuring safety excellence, maintaining quality standards, and delivering projects on schedule and within budget.
  
Core Responsibilities
  
Project Leadership & Execution
  
Lead overall construction management for high-rise greenfield projects encompassing site establishment, foundation works, superstructure construction,Post tensioning works, façade installation, MEP systems and sustainability integration,landscape and interior fit-out through to handover. Develop and implement comprehensive construction execution strategies aligned with project objectives and client requirements. Establish project governance frameworks including PEP,organizational structures, reporting protocols, and decision-making hierarchies. Direct project mobilization activities including site setup, temporary facilities, logistics planning, and resource deployment. Manage critical interfaces between construction phases,trade contractors,stakeholders and coordinate sequencing across multiple work fronts to optimize productivity and schedule performance.
  
Team Management & Leadership
  
Build and lead high-performing project teams including construction managers, engineers, coordinators, and site supervision staff. Provide clear direction, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to team members. Conduct regular performance reviews and implement capability development programs. Foster collaborative team culture focused on safety, quality, and delivery excellence. Interface with senior client representatives, consultants, contractors, and regulatory authorities at executive level. Chair senior project meetings including monthly progress reviews, risk workshops, and stakeholder coordination sessions.
  
Planning, Scheduling & Progress Management
  
Oversee master project scheduling and coordinate detailed construction sequencing across all trades and disciplines. Monitor critical path activities and implement recovery strategies when delays threaten milestone achievements. Direct look-ahead planning processes ensuring material procurement, workforce availability, and equipment resources align with construction requirements. Manage progress measurement systems and verify completed work against payment schedules. Coordinate tower crane operations, hoist schedules, and vertical material logistics specific to high-rise construction. Implement advanced construction methodologies including prefabrication strategies, off-site manufacturing integration, and vertical transportation optimization.
  
Contract & Commercial Management
  
Administer head contracts and manage relationships with principal contractors and major subcontractors. Oversee variation management processes including assessment, pricing negotiation, and approval workflows. Direct claims management and dispute resolution activities, escalating to senior management when required. Monitor commercial performance including cost forecasting, cash flow management, and budget tracking. Review and approve subcontractor payment certificates ensuring accuracy and contractual compliance. Manage extension of time claims and assess contractor entitlements under contract provisions.
  
Quality & Compliance Assurance
  
Ensure construction quality meets design specifications, building codes, and client requirements throughout all phases. Implement inspection and testing protocols specific to high-rise construction including concrete strength verification, structural steel connections, façade performance testing, and MEP systems commissioning. Review and approve method statements, risk assessments, and construction methodologies for high-risk activities including working at height, heavy lifting operations, and façade installation. Coordinate regulatory inspections and building authority approvals at key construction stages. Oversee defects management through punch list compilation, rectification tracking, and practical completion certification.
  
Safety, Health & Environment Leadership
  
Champion safety culture and ensure zero-harm principles are embedded across project operations. Enforce strict compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and industry best practices for high-rise construction. Conduct regular site safety inspections and participate in incident investigations with implementation of corrective actions. Oversee high-risk work activities including tower crane operations, edge protection systems, scaffolding, fall prevention measures, and confined space work. Monitor environmental compliance including dust suppression, noise management, waste disposal, and erosion control. Lead emergency response planning and ensure site preparedness for potential incidents.
  
Risk & Issue Management
  
Identify, assess, and manage project risks across technical, commercial, schedule, safety, and stakeholder dimensions. Develop risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans for high-impact scenarios. Monitor risk registers and implement proactive measures to minimize risk realization. Resolve complex technical and coordination challenges through systematic problem-solving and collaboration with design teams. Manage unforeseen conditions, design changes, and scope variations with minimal impact to project objectives.
  
Stakeholder & Client Relations
  
Serve as primary construction interface with client representatives and senior stakeholders. Prepare and present comprehensive progress reports, financial summaries, and risk assessments for client review meetings. Manage client expectations regarding schedule performance, budget status, and quality deliverables. Coordinate public relations activities and manage community engagement for projects in sensitive urban environments. Facilitate coordination with adjacent property owners, local authorities, and utility providers affected by construction activities.
  
Required Qualifications
  
Essential Experience
  
Minimum 15 to 18 years of progressive construction management experience with at least 8 years focused on high-rise buildings (15+ floors). Demonstrated track record managing greenfield projects from ground-breaking through completion and handover. Proven success delivering multiple high-rise projects on time and within budget. Experience with various contractual delivery methods including Design-Build, Construction Management, and Traditional Lump Sum contracts.
  
Technical Expertise
  
Deep understanding of high-rise construction methodologies including foundation systems (piled foundations, raft slabs,shoring systems(D-wall,micro piling) basement construction), core and outrigger structural systems, post-tensioned concrete construction, structural steel erection and connections, curtain wall and façade systems, and vertical transportation systems. Knowledge of MEP systems integration in high-rise buildings including electrical distribution, HVAC systems, plumbing and drainage, fire protection and life safety systems, and building automation systems. Familiarity with advanced construction technologies including BIM coordination and 4D scheduling, prefabrication and modular construction, crane and hoist logistics optimization, and construction management software platforms.
  
Education & Certifications
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.

title: Program Manager III, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.  
  
Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.  
  
We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of ~200+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.  
  
We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities -
  
  

* Define and manage cross-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones.
* Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health.
* Lead stakeholder alignment through clear written narratives and verbal communication, presenting program updates, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment.

Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. description:

Our collaborative team brings together technical supply chain experts, project managers, and operations leaders who thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. Your Impact

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. Details

Project Manager

To plan, coordinate, execute, and complete interior fit-out and furniture manufacturing projects within the approved budget, timeline, and quality standards. title: Program Manager - Engineering & Automation Projects , GESI-IN
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Program Manager – Automation & Engineering Projects drives end-to-end project governance for automation, capacity, and Innovation Lab initiatives within the GESI-IN (PMO/Ops Eng/Automation) team. This role is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of approved OP1/OP2 intake requests, maintaining the India Product Development System (IPDS) master tracker, and ensuring project health through continuous risk analysis and timely escalation. The Program Manager owns launch readiness planning with backward-scheduled timelines, coordinates cross-functional stakeholders across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners, and delivers executive-level business review narratives (WBR, MBR, QBR). Additionally, the role produces monthly newsletters, event-driven flash reports, and leads weekly project reviews and gate-review logistics to maintain cadence and accountability across all active programs.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Tracking all approved OP(OP1 & OP2) Intake requests (ATL/BTL Category) through Laminar intake flow on Capacity, automation initiatives, Innovation Lab, Study & assessment/any other category that requires GESI-IN (Ops Eng/Automation) team’s delivery.  
2. End to end monitor and control of project through continuous risk analysis at each phases by leveraging Source. Timely escalation of leadership support through proper technical write up & WP doc.
  
3. Own the Innovation lab’s master project tracker — India Product Development System (IPDS) phase, milestones, dev-cycle time, RAG status and payback for every active project. Keep it current and audit-ready.  
4. Create and maintain tracker of launch (ETA: Go-Live) backward updated status for timely actions/support.
  
5. Business Review Docs: Owning end to end details & quality of all automation/capacity/IL charters for narratives for all business review docs (WBR, MBR & QBR).
  
6. Monthly Innovation Lab Newsletter — project progress, wins, look ahead and team spotlights.  
7. Issue event-driven flash reports for gate outcomes, milestone hits and critical blockers for leadership attention.  
8. Coordinate across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners to keep cross-functional commitments on track.  
  
A day in the life  
A typical day begins with a standup reviewing project health dashboards on GES Source, flagging any RAG status shifts or emerging risks across active Engineering projects and automation charter. Mid-morning is spent updating tracker, aligning milestone timelines, and preparing concise escalation notes for leadership. After lunch, cross-functional syncs with Operations, RME, Finance, and vendor partners keep launch commitments on track. The afternoon wraps up drafting business review narratives or newsletter updates, followed by a gate-review prep session to finalize agendas and close out action items before end of day.  
  
About the team  
GESI-IN (Global Engineering Services & Innovation – India) is the team that delivers for Amazon's India network expansion and consolidation. The team partners with Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and all other cross functional teams to design, develop and deploy engineering solutions, capacity programs, and automation charters that improve safety, quality, and throughput at scale. The team takes ideas from concept through pilot to network-wide rollout. You will join a fast-paced, data-driven group that values deep-dive problem solving, cross-functional collaboration, and a bias for action to deliver measurable impact on the ground.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
* Experience in preventative maintenance systems

title: Infrastructure project manager and release manager
description:
The Infrastructure Change & Release Manager is responsible for governing, coordinating, and continuously improving the end to end Change Enablement and Release Management processes across enterprise IT infrastructure.  
The role ensures that infrastructure changes and releases are properly assessed, authorized, scheduled, communicated, implemented, and reviewed, while minimizing business disruption and maintaining service availability.  
The position works closely with Infrastructure Operations, Cloud, Network, Database, Security, Application, Service Management, Project/Program Management, and business teams.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Change Management / Change Enablement  
  
. Own and manage the enterprise Change Management / Change Enablement process.  
. Review infrastructure RFCs for completeness, technical readiness, risk, impact, dependencies, implementation plans, testing evidence, rollback plans, and business approvals.  
. Classify and manage: Standard Changes Normal Changes Emergency Changes  
. Facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) and, where required, Emergency CAB (ECAB) meetings.  
. Ensure high risk and business critical changes receive appropriate technical and business approvals.  
. Maintain the enterprise Change Calendar / Forward Schedule of Change (FSC).  
. Identify scheduling conflicts between infrastructure, application, security, maintenance, and release activities.  
. Coordinate changes across technologies including: Windows/Linux VMware/virtualization Azure/AWS/cloud infrastructure Network and firewall Database Storage and backup Middleware End user computing Cybersecurity infrastructure  
. Ensure changes comply with organizational governance, audit, security, and regulatory requirements.  
  
  
2. Release Management  
  
. Plan and coordinate infrastructure releases from development/testing through production deployment.  
. Develop and maintain release calendars and deployment schedules.  
. Coordinate release readiness across infrastructure, application, security, testing, operations, and business stakeholders.  
. Ensure releases have: Defined implementation plans Deployment sequencing Testing and validation evidence Business/service owner approval Communication plans Backout/rollback procedures Post deployment validation  
. Manage release dependencies across multiple technology platforms.  
. Coordinate major releases, infrastructure upgrades, migrations, patching programs, and transformation initiatives.  
. Ensure appropriate handover into BAU/Operations following deployment.  
  
  
3. Risk & Impact Management  
Perform or facilitate assessment of changes based on factors such as:  
  
. Business impact  
. Technical complexity  
. Service criticality  
. Number of affected users  
. Application/service dependencies  
. Implementation duration  
. Previous change history  
. Security implications  
. Customer impact  
. Rollback complexity  
  
Challenge high risk changes where implementation, testing, communication, or rollback arrangements are insufficient.  
  
4. CAB Governance  
Plan, chair, and govern CAB meetings.  
Typical responsibilities include:  
  
1. Review upcoming changes.  
2. Highlight high risk and high impact changes.  
3. Validate implementation and rollback readiness.  
4. Identify scheduling conflicts.  
5. Verify stakeholder approvals.  
6. Review business/service impact.  
7. Approve, reject, defer, or escalate changes in accordance with delegated authority.  
8. Track actions and decisions.  
9. Review failed and backed out changes.  
10. Ensure emergency changes are retrospectively reviewed.  
  
  
5. Major & Emergency Changes  
  
. Coordinate urgent infrastructure changes required to restore services or mitigate significant operational/security risk.  
. Facilitate ECAB approvals where required.  
. Ensure emergency procedures do not bypass essential technical and risk controls.  
. Coordinate with Major Incident Management during service restoration activities.  
. Ensure retrospective documentation and review of emergency changes.  
. Identify repeated emergency changes and drive appropriate problem management or automation improvements.  
  
  
6. Post Implementation Review  
Conduct or coordinate Post Implementation Reviews (PIRs) for:  
  
. Failed changes  
. Backed out changes  
. High risk changes  
. Changes resulting in incidents  
. Major releases  
. Emergency changes, where required  
  
Identify:  
  
. Root causes  
. Process failures  
. Planning deficiencies  
. Testing gaps  
. Execution problems  
. Documentation deficiencies  
. Preventive actions  
  
Track corrective actions through closure.

title: Senior Program Manager, Financial Deductions
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you ready to own the strategy that eliminates millions in vendor financial friction? Amazon's EU Financial Deductions Vendor Compliance Program (FD VCP) is seeking a Program Manager III to drive strategic program design, cross-functional stakeholder alignment, and scalable mechanism-building across our global vendor compliance ecosystem. You'll operate as a single-threaded owner with full autonomy — from problem definition to solution design, stakeholder alignment, launch, and impact measurement — turning pilot programs into scaled, multi-marketplace operations.  
  
This is not your typical program management role. You'll shape the strategic direction of a dual-service model — Proactive account management and E2E Financial dispute settlement — partnering closely with the Account Management leadership who owns business goals and team execution. Your focus will be on designing program frameworks, building governance mechanisms, driving vendor experience transformation (VSAT), and influencingcross-functional teams spanning FinOps, Amazon Vendor Services, Retail, Item and Supply Management, and Category Leadership to unlock operational efficiencies and sustained metric improvement at scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Drive continuous program improvement by defining success metrics, building measurement frameworks, and enabling data-driven decision making across WBR, MBR, QBR, and Account Manager Scorecard governance cadences  
  
Design and scale proactive vendor defect prevention programs across marketplaces by building globally replicable playbooks, operating models, and program frameworks that convert pilot programs into multi-marketplace operations  
  
Influence senior leadership stakeholders to secure investment decisions, resource allocation, and strategic buy-in for program growth by writing effective narratives (BRDs, PR-FAQs) and presenting to directors and vice presidents  
  
Partner with cross-functional teams (FinOps, AVS, Retail, ISM, Category Leadership) to define program strategy, set objectives, analyze data, and drive measurable improvements — proactively identifying and mitigating risks across teams, processes, and systems before they become roadblocks  
  
Own the vendor experience transformation roadmap (VSAT), designing engagement frameworks and feedback mechanisms that improve vendor satisfaction while partnering with Account Management leadership on execution and delivery  
  
About the team  
Join the EU FD VCP team where you'll own the strategic program roadmap that is driving millions in vendor financial recovery across Amazon's vendor compliance ecosystem — launching programs in new countries, designing scalable frameworks, and shaping the vendor experience across marketplaces. Our vision is to be recognized as the worldwide specialized center of excellence for Financial Deductions, empowering Retail and Amazon Vendor Services teams across all Amazon marketplaces with expert resolution support, proactive dispute prevention, and scalable financial health solutions that reclaim critical bandwidth and drive vendor satisfaction.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 5+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

On-Ground Execution:

Post-Event Wrap-Up

**⁠ ⁠**Lead post-event reviews, reconciling budgets and capturing learnings. Ensure timely closure of documentation and client feedback loops.

**⁠** ⁠6–10+ years of experience in project or event management, ideally in MICE, corporate events, or experiential marketing.

⁠ ⁠Proven track record managing large-scale events end-to-end.

⁠ ⁠Strong budgeting and financial tracking skills.

⁠ ⁠Experience managing team capacity and assigning work across multiple concurrent projects.

title: Project Coordinator – YCLC (Kolar - Karnataka)
description:
**Job Profile:**

**1. About Bindi International**

Bindi International Association is a grassroots organisation working at the intersection of education, gender equity, community wellbeing and climate action. The organisation works with underserved communities across India to strengthen access to education, build local leadership and enable communities to participate in sustainable development.

**2. About the Programme**

The Young Climate Leadership Curriculum (YCLC) aims to equip children and young people with the knowledge, skills and confidence to understand climate change and participate in meaningful climate action. Under the Climate Smart Communities initiative, YCLC connects climate education with practical interventions in schools and communities, helping students understand local environmental challenges, explore sustainable solutions and engage in collective action.

**The programme follows the Think–Speak–Act approach:**

- Think: Build understanding of climate change, environmental sustainability and locally relevant climate issues.

- Speak: Encourage students to express their perspectives, discuss solutions and communicate with peers and communities.

- Act: Enable students to lead climate action initiatives and campaigns within their schools and communities.

Climate Fellows will directly implement the curriculum in schools and facilitate student activities.

The Project Coordinator will provide leadership, coordination, mentoring and quality assurance to ensure effective implementation across 20 government schools and their surrounding communities.

**3. Role Overview**

The Project Coordinator will be responsible for the overall field-level implementation and coordination of YCLC across 20 government schools and their surrounding communities in Karnataka. The coordinator will manage and support Climate Fellows who will deliver curriculum sessions and facilitate student-led activities in schools. The role will involve developing implementation plans, coordinating with school authorities, mentoring fellows, monitoring programme quality and enabling students to translate climate learning into practical action.

The coordinator will also lead community engagement and support the planning and implementation of climate action campaigns involving students, Climate Fellows, teachers, families and community stakeholders. The position requires a proactive, field-oriented professional who can manage multiple stakeholders, ensure accountability for programme delivery and help build a culture of climate awareness, leadership and action across participating schools and communities.

**4. Key Responsibilities**

A. Programme Planning and School Coordination

- Lead the implementation of YCLC across 20 government schools in Karnataka through the Climate Fellows.

- Develop school-wise implementation plans, activity calendars and targets aligned with the approved programme work plan.

- Coordinate with school heads, teachers and relevant education authorities to facilitate programme approvals, scheduling and implementation.

- Establish clear school allocations, responsibilities and timelines for Climate Fellows.

- Ensure that fellows have the curriculum, facilitation guides, teaching materials and resources required for effective delivery.

- Conduct regular school visits to monitor implementation, observe selected sessions and address field-level challenges.

- Maintain an overview of programme progress across all 20 schools and take timely corrective action when implementation gaps arise.

**B. Climate Fellow Management, Mentoring and Support**

- Coordinate and oversee the work of Climate Fellows responsible for implementing YCLC in assigned schools.

- Orient fellows on the curriculum, Think–Speak–Act approach, climate education concepts, facilitation techniques and expected programme outcomes.

- Develop clear work plans and implementation targets for fellows, including school visits, curriculum sessions, student activities and community engagement.

- Conduct regular review meetings to track progress, discuss challenges and identify solutions.

- Provide ongoing mentoring, feedback and field-level support to strengthen fellows’ facilitation and coordination skills.

- Conduct periodic observations of curriculum sessions and provide constructive feedback on quality, student participation and learning.

- Monitor fellows’ attendance, field activities, session completion, documentation and reporting.

- Identify capacity-building needs and coordinate refresher training and peer-learning opportunities.

- Encourage fellows to share effective practices, local innovations and implementation learning across schools.

**C. Curriculum Implementation and Student Climate Leadership**

- Ensure that Climate Fellows implement the YCLC curriculum consistently while contextualising activities to local environmental issues and students’ lived experiences.

- Monitor the use of the Think–Speak–Act approach to strengthen critical thinking, communication, participation and action among students.

- Support fellows in facilitating classroom discussions, group activities, experiential learning, student projects and climate leadership exercises.

- Help students identify environmental challenges in their schools and communities and explore practical solutions.

- Connect classroom learning with relevant climate-smart interventions, such as solar electrification, composting, tree plantation, biodiversity conservation, beekeeping and green livelihood initiatives, where applicable.

- Encourage students to become climate leaders and ambassadors who can share their learning, mobilise peers and contribute to community-level change.

- Identify opportunities to strengthen student participation, creativity, ownership and leadership throughout programme implementation.

D. Community Engagement and Climate Action Campaigns

- Lead community engagement across the 20 participating schools and their surrounding

communities, working with Climate Fellows to connect climate education with local environmental priorities.

- Engage parents, community leaders, teachers, local institutions and other stakeholders in programme activities and climate action initiatives.

- Support Climate Fellows and students in identifying local climate and environmental challenges and translating their learning into practical, community-led action.

- Plan, coordinate and monitor climate action campaigns led by students and Climate Fellows on issues such as waste management, plastic reduction, water conservation, tree plantation, biodiversity, renewable energy and other locally relevant climate priorities.

- Enable students to design and participate in school-based and community-level campaigns, including awareness drives, rallies, action days, community meetings, pledges and practical environmental initiatives.

- Encourage students to mobilise peers, families and community members to participate in climate-positive actions.

- Build partnerships with schools, community groups, local institutions and relevant stakeholders to strengthen campaign participation and continuity.

- Connect campaigns with existing climate-smart interventions, including solar energy, composting, plantation, beekeeping and green livelihood initiatives, where relevant.

- Promote opportunities for students to share their climate learning with families and communities and encourage collective problem-solving.

- Document campaign participation, actions undertaken, community responses and outcomes to demonstrate programme progress.

- Ensure that campaigns move beyond awareness generation towards tangible climate action, community participation and sustained environmentally responsible practices.

**E. Monitoring, Evaluation and Programme Quality**

- Develop and maintain systems to track implementation across all 20 schools and their associated communities.

- Consolidate school-wise and fellow-wise progress data, including sessions conducted, student participation, activities completed and campaign implementation.

- Conduct regular field visits to verify reported progress and assess curriculum delivery and programme quality.

- Coordinate baseline and endline assessments, student feedback and other monitoring activities as required.

- Track progress against programme indicators and identify gaps requiring additional support or corrective action.

- Monitor the participation of students, teachers and community members in climate education and action initiatives.

- Use monitoring findings to strengthen implementation quality, improve student engagement and inform programme decisions.

- Ensure timely, accurate and complete reporting from Climate Fellows.

**F. Documentation, Reporting and Learning**

- Prepare regular programme progress reports for the Programme Lead or designated Programme Manager.

- Maintain updated school-wise implementation trackers, fellow activity records, attendance registers and documentation of programme activities.

- Document student-led climate action campaigns, community initiatives, local solutions and examples of emerging climate leadership.

- Capture case studies, student voices, field experiences and lessons learned from programme implementation.

- Document challenges, adaptations and effective practices that can inform future programme improvements.

- Ensure that photographs, stories and other documentation involving children are collected and used in accordance with safeguarding, consent and organisational policies.

- Contribute to programme reviews, presentations, donor reporting and other communication requirements as needed.

**G. Stakeholder Coordination and Programme Operations**

- Maintain regular communication with school authorities, Climate Fellows, community stakeholders, implementation partners and the central programme team.

- Coordinate training sessions, review meetings, school activities, community campaigns and programme events.

- Ensure timely distribution and appropriate use of curriculum materials and other programme resources.

- Manage field schedules, travel, logistics and activity-related documentation in accordance with approved budgets and organisational procedures.

- Maintain relevant administrative records and supporting documentation for programme expenditure.

- Adhere to organisational safeguarding, child protection, inclusion and ethical engagement standards in all school and community activities.

**6. Qualifications and Experience**

- Bachelor’s degree in Education, Environmental Studies, Climate Science, Social Sciences, Development Studies or a related discipline. Relevant practical experience may be considered.

- Approximately 2–4 years of experience in programme coordination, education, climate action, community development or youth engagement.

- Experience coordinating field teams, fellows, facilitators or community-based programme personnel.

- Experience working with government schools, teachers, children and rural communities will be an advantage.

- Familiarity with climate change, environmental sustainability, renewable energy, environmental education or community-led climate action.

- Experience organising awareness campaigns, community events, student activities or local action initiatives is desirable.

- Proficiency in Kannada and English. Knowledge of other languages relevant to the project geography will be an advantage.

- Willingness to travel regularly to participating schools and communities across the assigned geography.

**7. Key Skills and Competencies**

- Team management and mentoring: Ability to guide, motivate and support Climate Fellows to achieve programme targets.

- Field coordination: Strong planning, scheduling, implementation tracking and problem-solving

**skills.**

- School and community engagement: Ability to build relationships with school authorities, teachers, families and community stakeholders.

- Climate education: Interest in climate change, environmental sustainability and locally relevant climate solutions.

- Campaign planning: Ability to coordinate participatory campaigns and translate programme objectives into practical activities.

- Monitoring and documentation: Ability to maintain accurate records, analyse implementation progress and prepare reports.

- Communication and facilitation: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders.

- Ownership and accountability: Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently and maintain regular communication with programme leadership.

- Child-centred approach: Commitment to inclusive learning, student participation, safeguarding and enabling young people to exercise leadership.

**8. What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a proactive and accountable professional who believes that climate education must extend beyond awareness to meaningful participation and action. The ideal candidate will be able to support and guide Climate Fellows, build strong relationships with schools and communities, and ensure that students have opportunities to identify local environmental challenges and take action to address them.

They should combine strong implementation and team coordination skills with an understanding of community realities, a collaborative working style and a commitment to building climate-smart communities through education and youth leadership.

**9. Application Process**

Interested candidates should submit their updated CV to recruitment@bindi-international.org with subject line- Program Coordinator, young climate leadership curriculum -CSC and a brief cover note highlighting their relevant experience in programme coordination, team management, school engagement, climate education or community-led initiatives.

**Compensation**

**₹45,000 per month**

Pay: ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

Senior Engineering Manager

Each day, you will ensure that engineering activities are executed efficiently and in a cost-effective manner. You will also demonstrate your technical skills by providing technical support for commissioning and start-up activities.
